description: Land Title Settlement Department - Molakepupathana, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambanthota District   - Cad. Map No.830067 and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (No. 218 of Block 02) with detailed land particulars including owner information, extent, class of title, and location details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations and title determinations.
